configuration.query: What accounts have opportunities related to printer and electronics?
configuration.rephrase: The query will list out accounts which have opportunities with name containing 'printer' or 'electronics'
configuration.standardsql: SELECT * FROM [account] WHERE EXISTS (SELECT [opportunityid] FROM [opportunity] WHERE [opportunity].[parentaccountid] = [account].[accountid] AND ([opportunity].[name] LIKE '%printer%' OR [opportunity].[name] LIKE '%electronics%'))
